authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner laghu explicitly includes Khowar lʰoċ light, alongside Kalasha lihoċ. The survey loʦ/lōʦ forms fit this comparandum. Turner marks the historical extension with +?, so the identification is with this documented family rather than a claim that every sound or suffix has been explained.
